row.notes: Name kept for signatures.json; per verify-a it is the shared remove-from-race step, used before the penalty helper with code 6 or 7 (both callers 0x143572fc6, 0x1435738ec). For car byte idx (0xff = none): finds the participant (rules+0x1c30 +0xa0[idx] cache, else scan +0x88..+0x90) and, when participant flags +0x32 bit 0x20: sets bit 0x40 in the car's result flags ([[rules+0x1c40]+0x70][idx]+0x17c); if +0x30 bit 0 also: Game_Set_VehicleController(rules+0x1c28, idx, 1, 2) and stores the session-clock time + offset in rules+0x1d10[is_secondary]. (used by vmknolle race-start to prevent false DSQ)

verify.notes: V1024 for vehicle!=0xff: finds participant entry (cache +0x1c30+0xa0), if entry+0x32&0x20 sets bit 0x40 in result flags (+0x1c40->+0x70[v]+0x17c), and if entry+0x30&1 hands car to controller slot 1 via Set_VehicleController(…,v,1,2) and stores a session-time stamp at +0x1d10[idx]. Both callers set the 0x1d08/0x1d0c masks and then call penalty helper 0x1435668e0 with code 7 (0x143572f90) or 6 (0x1435737xx). Differs: it is the shared remove-from-race step used by two penalty paths, not DSQ-only
